rows.name: Dreadful Countenance

printed_cells.effect: Increasing debuff on agressive enemies up to 5 stages.

rows.class_row_html: 1 Dreadful Countenance Rising Dread Instant 6 Increasing debuff on agressive enemies up to 5 stages.
rows.detail_main_html:
Dreadful Countenance

Dread Knight · Level 1 · Rising Dread

Effect

Increasing debuff on agressive enemies up to 5 stages.

Notes

Seething Hatred, read from this same client, says it “Increases your Dreadful Countenance”. So the build carries this ability even though the spellbook does not list it, which is what the passive reasoning above predicted.

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “Your opponent begins to feel a sense of dread rising from within them. Incoming Critical: +5%, All Resistances: Reduced” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:dreadful-countenance-i)

Found on the client's General tab. The rosters captured for this archive are the Adventuring tab, which lists castables; passives and similar sit under General instead. So an ability missing from an Adventuring roster is not evidence it is missing from the build -- it may simply be on the other tab.

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.

Dreadful Countenance II

Dread Knight · Level 4 · Wave of Despair

Effect

Your opponent's fear of you mounts, as does the debilitation caused by it. Incoming Critical: +7%, All Resistances: Reduced, Incoming Spiritual Damage: +5%

Notes

Level: 5 Spell/Skill

Seething Hatred, read from this same client, says it “Increases your Dreadful Countenance”. So the build carries this ability even though the spellbook does not list it, which is what the passive reasoning above predicted.

Probably not a separate rank. The client shows a single unranked Dreadful Countenance at level 1 whose debuff builds “up to 5 stages”, and this row's wording -- the opponent's fear mounting, with the debilitation it causes -- reads like a description of one of those stages rather than a second ability. It is kept because only two abilities from the General tab have been seen so far, which is not enough to say what else is on it.
